    fr = F.rank(fwd)

            if ok.sum() > 30:

NAME = '지난 250일로 날마다 다시 맞춘 선형 식(종가만, 앞날 없이)'
H = 10; W = 250; LAM = 50.0
def feats(F):
    fs = [F.zcs(F.rel(5)), F.zcs(F.rel(20)), F.zcs(F.rel(60)), F.zcs(F.rel(120)), F.zcs(F.vol(20)),
          F.zcs(F.hi(60)), F.zcs(F.ma(20)), F.zcs(F.beta(60)), F.zcs(F.ret(1)), F.zcs(F.updays(20))]
    return [np.nan_to_num(f) for f in fs]
def score(F):
    X = np.stack(feats(F), axis=2)               # D,N,K
    D, N, K = X.shape
    C = F.C
    y = np.full((D, N), np.nan)
    y[:-H] = np.log(C[H:] / C[:-H])              # 날 d 에서 H 뒤 값(t>=d+H 에서만 씀)
    y = y - np.nanmean(y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    ok = np.isfinite(y); y0 = np.where(ok, y, 0.0); Xm = X * ok[:, :, None]
    A = np.einsum('dnk,dnj->dkj', Xm, X); b = np.einsum('dnk,dn->dk', Xm, y0)
    cA = np.cumsum(A, 0); cb = np.cumsum(b, 0)
    S = np.full((D, N), np.nan)
    for t in range(D):
        e = t - H
        if e < W // 2 + 60: continue
        s = max(-1, e - W)
        As = cA[e] - (cA[s] if s >= 0 else 0); bs = cb[e] - (cb[s] if s >= 0 else 0)
        beta = np.linalg.solve(As + LAM * np.eye(K), bs)
        S[t] = X[t] @ beta
    S[~np.isfinite(F.C)] = np.nan
    return S

def feats(F):
